description: This file defines the navigation graph for a Jetpack Compose Android app, including route constants, composable functions for navigation setup, and functions to add specific screens (Home and Details) to the navigation graph. It interacts with a SampleRepository to provide data to screens.

methods.name: AppNavGraph
methods.description: Composable function that sets up the application's navigation graph with start destination and serveral navigation routes.

methods.name: addHome
methods.description: Adds the Home screen route to the navigation graph, defining navigation behavior when the home route is active.

methods.name: addDetails
methods.description: Adds the Details screen route to the navigation graph, handling the retrieval of item ID from arguments and navigation back actions.
